pages.title: The Ring
pages.text: $(bold)The Core at the centre. Each dot is a node, coloured by its road. Red rings are still sealed; each padlock is a seal.

pages.title: Rings
pages.text: $(bold)$(thing)15 rings$(n) out from the Core, each with a name: Stone Age, Copper Age, Iron Age, out to Eye Ring.$(br2)A node needs the node before it, whatever else it needs, and its ring unsealed.

$(bold)Cost climbs with the ring: a few shards on ring 2, about a hundred on ring 14.$(br2)Seals count how many nodes you own, not which. Breadth gets you out, not one long road.$(br2)Costs in this book are Hard costs. On Normal nodes cost 5% less, on Easy a quarter less.
